issues.title: `build_v552_structural_outputs` is defined twice
issues.defect: The module contains two top-level definitions of the main builder; Python silently uses the later definition while the earlier implementation remains as shadow architecture.
issues.evidence: AST/static audit during hostile pass; active definition is the later one around line ~4852.
issues.consequence: Edits can land in dead code; duplicated helper ecosystems obscure which semantics are live.
issues.required: Patch/test the active later builder only, then remove/quarantine the dead builder and dead-only helpers in a separate cleanup commit after semantic migration is green.

issues.title: V552 independently re-solves scale/intensity representation
issues.defect: V552 reconstructs signed components from response direction/intensity/scale representation instead of treating V551 canonical signed projection as authoritative input.
issues.evidence: Identified in active V552 scale encoding / component resolution paths.
issues.consequence: A second projection engine can disagree with V551 on neutral, ordinal coordinates, missing intensity and authority status.
issues.required: Consume only valid V551 canonical signed fields for relation pressure. Remove authoritative V552 scale-family/coordinate inference.
tests: Complete clean distributions reproduce expected v2.1.4 pressure under canonical V551 projection.

issues.title: Neutral represented mass can be treated as mixed/ineligible component state
issues.affected: V551 pressure fields → active V552 component permission
issues.defect: Neutral atoms are valid relation evidence but V551 marks them `COVERAGE_ONLY_NEUTRAL` / pressure-ineligible. V552 can interpret a +/-/neutral distribution as mixed component permission rather than represented neutral mass with zero signed contribution.
issues.evidence: Observed in hostile pass against active V552 permission logic.
issues.consequence: Lawful mixed distributions can be blocked or have denominators distorted.
issues.required: In V552, neutral contributes represented mass and signed contribution zero. It must not cause `MIXED_COMPONENT_PERMISSION` or be discarded from denominator.
tests: Neutral-only complete distribution yields genuine observed zero pressure.

issues.title: V552 normalization can silently renormalize unresolved repair debt away
issues.defect: Current normalization uses observed/selected component weights over available mass. That is lawful for intentionally selected-category partial surfaces, but unsafe when missing mass represents V551 adjudication/repair debt.
issues.evidence: Existing accepted V552 behavior explicitly allowed selected-category partiality; new V551 repair debt is not currently distinguished.
issues.consequence: Unknown applicable evidence can disappear and surviving atoms be renormalized to 100%, overstating observed pressure.
issues.required: Consume V551 distribution coverage. Normalize conditionally only for intentional selected-surface partiality; retain unresolved applicable mass explicitly and prevent authoritative full-distribution claims.
tests: Intentional selected partial reproduces accepted conditional pressure.
Repair-debt partial does not renormalize unresolved mass away.

issues.title: No V551 atoms is treated as hard blockage rather than typed no-evidence
issues.defect: Current V552 emits `BLOCKED_V552_NO_RELATION_ATOMS` for zero atoms, making a valid no-applicable/no-promotable evidence state impossible.
issues.evidence: Observed in active V552 status logic during hostile pass.
issues.consequence: Absence, unresolved debt, and compiler failure are collapsed.
issues.required: Allow valid empty relation input when V551 manifest integrity passes; emit typed evidence state distinguishing no applicable evidence from applicable-but-unresolved.
tests: No applicable directional evidence → integrity PASS + typed absence, not zero pressure.

issues.title: Compiler execution mode overwrites semantic readiness/evidence status
issues.defect: After the builder computes evidence-dependent status, the compiler assigns a provisional READY status based on `--strict-handoff`, effectively making readiness reflect invocation mode rather than evidence reality.
issues.evidence: Hostile pass traced `READY_V552_STRUCTURAL_PRESSURE_CONTRACT` assignment under strict handoff.
issues.consequence: A structurally valid invocation can claim READY despite absent/unresolved evidence; validators then encode the same conflation.
issues.required: Separate `run_integrity_status`, `evidence_status`, `downstream_permission_status`, and `execution_mode`. Execution mode may authorize publication but must not rewrite evidence status.
tests: Changing strict-handoff flag does not alter evidence_status for identical inputs.

issues.title: V552 compiler and validator are formula/version-coupled and must migrate atomically
issues.defect: Validator recomputes v2.1.4-specific pressure formulas/contracts. Changing neutral/coverage semantics in only the compiler or only the validator will create false failures or permit old/new contract mixing.
issues.evidence: Current constants include V552 pressure formula v2.1.4 / handoff v552_structural_handoff_v2_1_4.
issues.consequence: Partial migration yields incompatible artifacts with misleading validation results.
issues.required: Bump/define new measurement and handoff contract versions; update compiler and independent validator in the same change set; reject old/new mixing.
tests: Compiler/validator agree on all new neutral/partial/no-evidence fixtures.
